details: हमारी जो अगली उड़ान स्कीम बनने वाली है, उसमें हम जरूर मालदा का उल्लेख करके उसको पूरी तरह से डेवलप करेंगे। इसके लिए हमारी तरफ से जरूरी कोशिश रहेगी।

records.title: promotion of Multilingualism under NEP 2020
details: a to c: As per the budget announcement of 2025-26, Government has proposed to implement a Bharitya Bhasha Pustak Scheme wherein the textbooks and study materials for the subjects being offered for schools and higher education shall be made available in 22 Indian languages in digital form. The Note for EFC for the scheme has been prepared with inputs from various stakeholders through a series of meetings.

records.title: Artemis Programme
details:
b: It is planned to launch one Indian astronaut aboard Crew Dragon of SpaceX for the upcoming ISRO-NASA joint mission to the International Space Station (ISS) under the Spaceflight Agreement with M/s. Axiom Space INC, USA.
c: The launch is expected during second quarter (Q2) of 2025.
